references.text: Parallel text describing the original instructions for the corner bars of the tabernacle, where they were to be double from the bottom and fully joined to the top at the first ring.
The context for building the tabernacle's planks and their interconnection, providing background on how the corner bars were constructed.
The original instructions given to Moses regarding the tabernacle's planks and corner construction, which are now being carried out in chapter 36.
